Step outside into the fresh air and take in uninterrupted panoramic views. The open-air viewing carriage offers a unique perspective, making it easy to capture unforgettable photos and immerse yourself in New Zealand's spectacular landscapes.
Discover the flavours of the South Island aboard the TranzAlpine Scenic Plus experience, with a seasonal menu inspired by the Canterbury Plains, Southern Alps and West Coast.
Our menu is subject to seasonal change. Please advise us of any dietary requirements at the time of booking.
